capabilities: Export notes and folders to HWPX files
Format output through editable HWPX templates with markers
Capture Mermaid diagrams and SVG files as images
Inspect templates for markers and typos
Expose export tools to AI agent plugins via agentinterop
extras: Desktop only because it reads and writes files with Node's fs module. No network access, telemetry or account. Third-party code-block renderers are opt-in with a warning to enable them only for trusted notes. Bundles marked, JSZip, fast-xml-parser and gray-matter under MIT licenses.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce Hangul (Hancom Office) HWPX documents, which Korean report and submission workflows require.

relations.evidence: The converter is derived from pypandoc-hwpx (MIT)

requires.name: Hangul (Hancom Office) or another HWPX viewer

summary: Exports Markdown notes to Hancom HWPX documents formatted by editable HWPX templates, with an MCP-like API for AI agent plugins.
